answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the garden of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A orchard of per-task receipts records who did what, and the sonnet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
